apps.title: Todo Master
apps.subtitle: Today, in order.
apps.description: A to-do manager that reads one plain-language line and sets the due date, priority, and repeat rule from it. Subtasks, today's focus, backup and restore — all inside your browser.
apps.thumbnailAlt: Todo Master screen: the Today's Focus tab with its task list and progress summary.

apps.title: Photos
apps.subtitle: A quiet photo library.
apps.description: A photo library that carries the feel of the iOS Photos app. Albums, EXIF details, filter adjustments, a secret album, and member passcode sign-in, all in a single static page.
apps.thumbnailAlt: Photos screen: the library collection with the guest-mode notice above a photo grid.

apps.title: Film Studio
apps.subtitle: Nine films, one browser.
apps.description: A WebGL2 film simulator that develops color through nine original film profiles. Tune 3D LUTs and grain in real time, and your photos never leave the device.
apps.thumbnailAlt: Film Studio screen: photo opening and adjustment samples beside the list of nine film signatures.

apps.title: Machine Learning Lab
apps.subtitle: Learn by experiment.
apps.description: A machine-learning study site that runs across seven chapters and five labs. Concepts, calculations, comparison diagrams, and notebooks, practiced right in the browser.
apps.thumbnailAlt: Machine Learning Lab screen: the study site cover with data, model, and experiment diagrams.
